about_the_game:
Camp Buddy: Scoutmaster Season - Side Stories is BLits Games' first-ever DLC, featuring six alternate scenarios with several of the game's supporting cast - including Hyunjin Choi, Lloyd Sirius, Darius Najjar and fan-favorite, Naoto Hamasaki!

Play through the game's main storyline to encounter these special scenarios in place of the normal scenes you might encounter throughout the game. Whether it's hitting the gym with Lloyd and Darius, soaking in the sauna with Naoto, or living out your fantasies with Hyunjin, these are spicy scenarios you don't want to miss!

Six New Special Scenarios

Unlock six new special scenarios - three on Aiden's Route, and three on Goro's route, featuring Darius Najjar, Lloyd Sirius, Hyunjin Choi, and Naoto Hamasaki! Get to know these characters more intimately with special, spicy scenarios - all fully animated, voice acted and uncensored!

New Unlockable Images!

Enjoy five (5) new unlockable image sets, each with animation and voice acting available immediately upon downloading in both the game's secret crack gallery and sex scene replay feature! Not only that, but four (4) brand new, never before seen Mini-images will appear throughout the DLC story, available in the game's mini-image gallery as well!

More Minigames!

Test out your teasing skills with four new characters in the foreplay minigame - Lloyd Sirius, Darius Najjar, Hyunjin Choi and Naoto Hamasaki! Choose your favorite costume, sexual position and get to the good stuff with these replayable scenes!

Bonus Content - More Crack Images!

FInally, enjoy four (4) additional, Holiday-themed crack images, unlocked immediately upon purchase inside the crack gallery! These special image sets are available for your viewing pleasure inside of Camp Buddy: Scoutmaster Season now!
